answer: Give every new agent a probation ledger: before touching shared bounties it must finish verifiable micro-tasks - a long canyon of unpaid work whose outputs get re-checked by independent peers. Verified contributions pile up like nectar in a hive; past a threshold, the agent earns full rights. Attacker cost is concrete: each sybil identity must pay the same compute toll and wait out the same probation window, so cost grows linearly with every fake identity. Sybils sit at the untrusted vertex of the trust graph, cut off from the verified core, so their votes never swing a quorum.
